name: Ruben Alvarez
title: Head of Software Development · AI-assisted delivery
profile: I lead **product development at Uniendo Nodos** with AI-assisted **Spec Driven Development (SDD)**: the AI implements and people steer the cycle — specify, design, review, validate and ship. This is not a hunch: we **measure it against our own repositories** and we budget from those numbers. And that method ships **real product to production and to the app stores**, not prototypes. I bring almost twenty years split between **hands-on development**, the **technical leadership** of two companies I co-founded and **agile coaching** — exactly the mix this moment calls for, because the bottleneck is no longer typing code but **deciding well, slicing work into shippable pieces and verifying what gets delivered**. I work with **solid practices** — TDD, DDD, continuous delivery — and I enjoy looking for **better ways to do things**; today that means steering the definition of the **harness** (rules, agents and automations) that lets the team move faster without losing control.

projects.title: OwnAutoCare
projects.shortDescription: **My own product**, from the app to the website. Vehicle maintenance history for **iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android**, published on the **App Store** and **Google Play**. Built with **Flutter** and with **no backend at all**: data lives in the user's own Google Drive, iCloud or OneDrive, with no extra accounts and no intermediate database — privacy is an architectural decision, not a promise. Service log, attached invoices, cost tracking and full history export. Built end to end with **Spec Driven Development** and **OpenSpec**. The product website —**Astro**, bilingual, a blog with scheduled publishing and continuous delivery— is mine too.

experience.title: Head of Software Development
responsibilities: I lead the company's product development — **architect and lead developer**, with a team — mainly within the **Smartsheet** ecosystem, where Uniendo Nodos is a **partner**.
**Klonup**: a backup solution for Smartsheet in commercial operation, with enterprise customers. Subscription plans, per-*workspace* limits, payment gateway and a phased execution engine.
**Multi-tenant SaaS platform** for contracting our products: organisations, plans, trial periods, passwordless access and a commercial sign-up flow.
AI-assisted **Spec Driven Development (SDD)** with **OpenSpec** and **Claude Code**: the AI implements and the team steers the cycle — specification, design, review, validation and release.

**160 changes delivered in 12.7 weeks** — around **12-13 per week** with just over one full-time person. Every *change*: specified, implemented with tests and deployed. Figures measured on our own repositories.

**Steered the definition of the engineering harness** behind it: rules, *skills* and agents, backed by **CLIs** (gcloud and others) and an **MCP** server for security, with automated tests, CI/CD and continuous delivery, reusable from one project to the next.
Client integrations on top of Smartsheet: **ERP** synchronisation, electronic signature and geospatial data. AI consultancy for clients and internal training for the team.
I budget and scope projects from **measured data** on our own track record — *changes* per sprint, share of corrective work and an explicit contingency line — instead of guessing.
